name: Almond Yogurt
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated for SIBO as it's lactose-free and doesn't contain high FODMAP ingredients when made from almonds.
preparationTips: Check ingredient labels for added inulin, chicory root, or high FODMAP thickeners
Choose plain varieties to avoid high FODMAP fruit additions
Look for brands without carrageenan if you have sensitive digestion
Shake well before serving as separation is normal
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of vitamin E from almonds
Often fortified with calcium and vitamin D
Lower in protein than dairy yogurt but lactose-free
